nodes.rationale: Future field extraction follows completed Markdown and should not change the current PDF-to-Markdown parser; fields, deployment, and acceptance criteria remain undecided.

nodes.label: Whole-page visual parsing
nodes.rationale: Sol reads the complete page image and owns text, tables, and semantic structure; V3 regions are layout guidance, not transcription.
